newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $65.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $65.00 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with the bulk of trade Tuesday, according to USDA. Inquiry was strong and demand fairly strong.
Sales were confirmed on 7,500 slaughter steers and 4,900 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 102,600 head confirmed including 26100 head or about 22 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
